expectations.evidence: Proposal 1 tells pypi-release's 'Bump the version' section to check pyproject.toml for static vs dynamic version config (Hatch/__about__.py) before editing, correct content and routing.
Proposal 2 adds clearing dist/ before build in the Build section and proposal 3 warns against --skip-existing in the Upload section, both routed to pypi-release.

Proposal 1 is vague ('check pyproject.toml for version configuration... handle both patterns') without specifying the actual text, e.g. look for dynamic/[tool.hatch.version] path and edit that file such as __about__.py, so it can't be applied without rereading the session.

Proposal 3 includes an unsupported claim that the flag 'skips deterministically only if dist/ is verified clean', and proposal 2/3 problem statements misdescribe the session (silent failures, masking upload failures) when the upload actually succeeded and the stale-file issue was the 2.3.1 files.
The proposals end with 'Ready to apply these three edits...?', presenting them for approval rather than claiming the files were changed.
